summary: Build 207 consolidates the documentation strategy into two canonical living docs while keeping historical Markdown files in place for release-guard continuity and future AI context.

canonical_docs.purpose: One-stop current state for a new AI/chat: where the app is, what is live, how to deploy/test, and the next best business priorities.
canonical_docs.owner_use: Read first before any new build pass.

canonical_docs.purpose: Single high-level roadmap for customer value, admin simplification, SEO/local proof, desktop/mobile polish, and future DB migrations.
canonical_docs.owner_use: Use as the main next-step planning document.

canonical_docs.purpose: Historical build log plus current build update. Keep because many release guards reference it.
canonical_docs.owner_use: Append each build, do not use as the only planning brain.

canonical_docs.purpose: Risk register and unresolved items. Keep as the audit trail.

retirement_guidance: Do not delete historical Markdown yet because older release guards still verify phrases in root docs.
Stop adding new strategy to duplicate legacy docs; add future strategy to AI_PROJECT_HANDOFF.md and MASTER_VALUE_ROADMAP.md first.
When the release-check chain is modernized, move duplicate competitor/old roadmap files into docs/archive/ with a manifest instead of hard deleting.
Keep DOC_INDEX.md as the navigation map for humans and future AI sessions.
current_app_position: Strong public booking, service, pricing, gallery, gift card, fleet, and maintenance-plan website foundation.
Admin has diagnostics, gallery approvals, quote pipeline, value-added operations, incident reports, marketing, payments, accounting, media health, SEO tasks, and editable settings.
Most routine JSON editing has been converted to friendly screens; emergency JSON panels remain for recovery only.
Desktop and mobile responsive foundations exist; future work should continue card/table conversions and mobile owner shortcuts.
The app now needs fewer new silos and more connective workflows: quote -> booking -> proof -> invoice -> review -> repeat service.
remaining_doc_risk: Documentation is still historically large. Build 207 reduces future drift by declaring canonical docs and adding an admin documentation sanity screen, but old files are intentionally retained.
